data.title: Billionaire David Tepper Piled Into a Debt-Laden Artificial Intelligence (AI) Neocloud Stock in Q2 While Also Increasing His Stake in Its Newest Rival
data.description: David Tepper's hedge fund, Appaloosa Management, recently initiated a position in CoreWeave while also raising its exposure to Meta Platforms.
data.keywords: David Tepper, Appaloosa Management, Meta Platforms, debt instruments
